seo.title: Eden Regal Ballroom & Catering · Weddings, Mitzvahs & Quinceañeras in Hollywood, FL
seo.description: Weddings, bar & bat mitzvahs and quinceañeras at Eden Regal Ballroom & Catering in Hollywood, Florida: ballroom, sanctuary and open-air terrace for up to 500 guests and Glatt Kosher catering under ORB supervision. Production by Avinu Events.

hero.lead: A family-run ballroom, sanctuary and open-air terrace in Hollywood, with space for up to 500 guests and a Glatt Kosher kitchen supervised by the ORB.

intro.h2: One property for the ceremony, the dinner and the dance floor
paras: Eden Regal Ballroom & Catering is a family business: a kosher catering and party venue in Hollywood, with beautiful indoor and outdoor settings and a ballroom with a stage for performers, a large dance floor and a fully equipped bar.
Weddings, bar and bat mitzvahs, quinceañeras and special events are planned step by step with the Eden team, one celebration at a time.

items.label: Weddings
items.title: Weddings
items.text: Say your vows in the sanctuary or outdoors, then move into the ballroom for dinner and dancing, with a private bridal room for getting ready.
points: Sanctuary for ceremonies, open-air terrace for outdoor vows
Stage, large dance floor and full bar in the ballroom
Ceremony music, DJ and lighting by Avinu Events
items.cta: Plan a wedding at Eden Regal

items.label: Bar & Bat Mitzvahs
items.title: Bar & Bat Mitzvahs
items.text: A Glatt Kosher kitchen under ORB supervision, and a ballroom with a stage and a big dance floor for the party.
points: Glatt Kosher menus: meat, parve or dairy
Saturday events can start 30 minutes after sundown
DJ, MC, dancers and LED by Avinu Events
items.cta: Plan a mitzvah at Eden Regal

items.label: Quinceañeras & Sweet 16
items.title: Quinceañeras & Sweet 16
items.text: A draped ballroom that takes any theme, from a grand entrance to the last song, with a menu of Latin, Caribbean and Mediterranean cuisines.
points: Stage and dance floor for the entrance and waltz
Parties that can run until 4 AM with no overtime charge
Dancers, DJ and lighting by Avinu Events
items.cta: Plan a quinceañera at Eden Regal

spaces.text: A newly renovated banquet hall for 50 to 500 guests, a sanctuary for ceremonies and an open-air terrace.

items.name: The Regal Ballroom
items.text: A draped ballroom with a stage for performers, an enormous dance floor and a fully equipped bar.

items.name: The Sanctuary
items.text: High ceilings, stained glass windows and a prominent altar, for ceremonies of up to 500 people.

items.name: The Open-Air Terrace
items.text: Outdoor ceremonies, cocktail hours or receptions for up to 300 people, with the ceremony moving indoors if the weather turns.

spaces.note: Banquet hall for 50 to 500 guests. Room-by-room capacities and floor plans available from the venue.

cuisine.h2: Fresh cuisine, Glatt Kosher and beautifully plated
paras: Led by Executive Chef Isaac Bruk, Eden's culinary team creates menus with fresh ingredients, combining Latin, Caribbean and Mediterranean cuisines, Jewish recipes and French classics.
The kitchen is Glatt Kosher under strict ORB supervision, whether the menu is meat, parve or dairy. Guests of any background are welcome to celebrate here.

reviews.src: Testimonials from cateringbyeden.com and WeddingWire · Rating from Google

items.q: Every detail was handled with so much care and heart. The food, the décor, the flow of the event. Everything exceeded our expectations.
items.who: The Sapir Family · Pembroke Pines, Florida · cateringbyeden.com

items.q: The food is always fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. We only eat kosher food, and Eden consistently delivers the quality we trust for our family and guests.
High ceilings, glossy floors, great stage for my DJ.

production.text: Avinu Events produces the entertainment for celebrations across South Florida, from Hollywood to Boca Raton: the music for the ceremony, the energy of the dance floor and the light that shapes the room.
production.lighting: Uplighting on the draped walls, dance-floor and stage lighting designed around the ballroom.
